tasks.title: Resilient Data Models & Graph Extensions
tasks.description: Extend NodeType and EdgeType with new variants and #[serde(other)] Unknown fallback; add deserialization mismatch guard in ProjectGraph::load to trigger clean re-indexing; define SnippetPreview and EntityMatch structures in src/core/graph.rs without serializing snippets into .project-map.json.

tasks.title: Entity Extractors for SQL, YAML (serde_yaml), and Env Files
tasks.description: Implement fast line-by-line split for .env* files, serde_yaml for Docker Compose/YAML configs (extracting environment, KAFKA_TOPIC_*, input-topics, output-topic), and Tree-Sitter sequel for SQL DDL tables in src/core/parser.rs.

tasks.title: Code Scanners with Concrete Kafka Directional Heuristics
tasks.description: Implement AST & string scanners in Kotlin, Python, Rust, and TS with concrete heuristics: to/send/produce/output-topic -> Producer; from/subscribe/consume/GlobalKTable/input-topics -> Consumer; fallback -> Reference; plus System.getenv and os.environ detection in src/core/parser.rs.

tasks.title: On-Demand Snippet Extraction & Query Engine
tasks.description: Implement lazy SnippetExtractor that slices files from disk on-demand with 1-based line numbers and per-session line caching (never stored in index); update QueryEngine and toon.rs to display categorized producers/consumers/config with markdown code blocks.

tasks.title: CLI Preview Flags & Conforming MCP Payloads
tasks.description: Add --preview / -C flags to CLI commands in src/cli/commands.rs; format CallToolResult.content with line-numbered markdown code fences and enrich MCP JSON responses with role and preview fields in src/mcp/server.rs.

tasks.title: Incremental Watcher & Test Suite Verification
tasks.description: Update watcher in src/core/watcher.rs to monitor .env, .sql, and .yaml files; add test fixtures and integration tests in tests/; verify backwards compatibility and cargo test passing.
